title: Sharing Performance Stats
content:
Link Sharing
To share your performance stats page with friends, family, and social media followers, follow these steps:
Navigate to your performance stats page on the trading platform.
Look for the "Share" button.
Click the slider to enable link sharing and click "Copy Link" to generate a view-only access link.
Paste and share it via email, messaging apps, or post it on your social media profiles.
Your contacts will be able to view your trading performance stats without being able to make any changes.

Link Sharing

To share your performance stats page with friends, family, and social media followers, follow these steps:

  1. Navigate to your performance stats page on the trading platform.

  2. Look for the "Share" button.

  3. Click the slider to enable link sharing and click "Copy Link" to generate a view-only access link.

  4. Paste and share it via email, messaging apps, or post it on your social media profiles.

Your contacts will be able to view your trading performance stats without being able to make any changes.
